$comment: Feature Map (Lauren Poteto Rule 3): connects user-visible SPIL AURA features to entry points, prerequisites, navigation steps, code anchors, and expected results.

features.title: Home Chat & Co-work Panel
prerequisites: Aura running on local/Cobalt test config
features.expectedResult: Chat pane stays >= 320 px wide with zero horizontal overflow or raw JSON leaks.

features.title: Orders List & Search
features.expectedResult: Orders load read-only without console/IPC errors; no ERP write is triggered.

features.title: Settings -> AI Models & Providers
features.expectedResult: Every <button> inside a <form> has an explicit type attribute; no secret values rendered.

features.title: Helpers & Desk Sign Routing
features.expectedResult: Helpers display by sign; zero errors in console or IPC.
